- `content/` is bilingual: keep `_index.de.md` and `_index.en.md` siblings with mirrored front matter; sync `title`, `date`, `draft`, `weight`, `archetype`; prefer ISO timestamps.
- Extend `layouts/partials/` and `layouts/shortcodes/`, not `themes/hugo-theme-relearn`. Shared styling: `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css`; pass-through files: `static/`; refresh generated `public/` / `resources/` only via `hugo --cleanDestinationDir`.
- Store reusable diagrams in `svg/` or beside embedding Markdown. Use Hugo Extended v0.120+.
- YAML front matter; `#` page titles, `##`/`###` sections; prefer Markdown lists/tables over HTML. Domain-named folders, lowercase filenames, media near pages.
- Use `{{% notice %}}`, `{{< svg icon="..." >}}`, mermaid fences; keep styling in `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css`.
- Preview: `hugo server --disableFastRender -D --buildFuture --navigateToChanged` (http://localhost:1313/gt-user-manual/). Disk preview: `hugo server --renderToDisk --printUnusedTemplates`.
- Deploy: `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings --cleanDestinationDir`. Run `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings` before every commit; today that build is the test suite. Add `--i18n-warnings --printUnusedTranslations --printPathWarnings` to check language alignment/orphaned layouts.
- Spot-check `public/search/index.json` and affected HTML in Chromium and Firefox.
- Use focused imperative commits (e.g., `docs: explain tenantportfolio filters`). Include regenerated `public/` artifacts when published site changes; avoid mixing content tweaks with layout/CSS overrides.
- PRs: list touched sections, link Grafioschtrader issues, attach screenshots or zipped `public/` previews for styling changes, and state whether `hugo --gc --minify` ran clean.
